title: fix(service-settings): the Default timezone help says what the setting does, in every locale
body:
Fixes #22136

Clause-②: no

The Default timezone help that an administrator reads in Settings → Localization and in the first-run timezone prompt (objectstack-ai/objectui#11758) named formula functions and an analytics term. It now says what the setting does, in plain words, in the manifest and in all four built-in packs. This is the wording half of the maintainer's ask; the browser-zone pre-selection half already shipped in objectui. The maintainer's words:

> 首次进入应用时，时区设置弹窗写的是 "IANA zone for today()/daysFromNow…"。应改成白话，并自动预选浏览器所在时区。

## What changed, per served string

| Where | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| manifest `description` (`localization.manifest.ts`) | IANA zone used to resolve today()/daysFromNow, analytics date buckets, and rendered datetimes. | Decides what "today" means in formulas, how reports group dates, and how dates and times are shown. Accepts any IANA time zone name (e.g. Europe/Paris). |
| `en` help | IANA zone for today()/daysFromNow, analytics date buckets, and rendered datetimes. | Decides what "today" means in formulas, how reports group dates, and how dates and times are shown. Accepts any IANA time zone name (e.g. Europe/Paris). |
| `es-ES` help | Zona IANA usada para resolver today()/daysFromNow, los buckets de fecha de analítica y las fechas/horas renderizadas. | Determina qué significa «hoy» en las fórmulas, cómo agrupan las fechas los informes y cómo se muestran las fechas y horas. Acepta cualquier nombre de zona horaria IANA (p. ej. Europe/Madrid). |
| `ja-JP` help | today()/daysFromNow の解決、分析の日付バケット、日時レンダリングに使う IANA タイムゾーン。 | 数式での「今日」がどの日か、レポートでの日付のまとめ方、日付と時刻の表示方法を決めます。任意の IANA タイムゾーン名（例:Asia/Tokyo）を指定できます。 |
| `zh-CN` help | 用于 today()/daysFromNow、分析日期分桶和 datetime 渲染的 IANA 时区。 | 决定公式中的"今天"是哪一天、报表如何按日期分组,以及日期和时间如何显示。可填写任意 IANA 时区名称(如 Asia/Shanghai)。 |

Why "IANA" stays, as a second sentence: the field is a free-text combobox (objectui `SettingsField`'s `DomainCombobox`, because the key declares `valueDomain: 'iana_time_zone'`), and the server accepts any IANA zone, not only the 17 listed. An administrator who types a zone needs to know the format. The first sentence carries no standard name.

No setting key, default (`UTC`), accepted value or behaviour changes. No `packages/spec`, no `settings-service*.ts`.

## Which layer is served (and so where the pin reads)

The console's `useSettingsLabel().fieldHelp` resolves `settings.localization.keys.timezone.help` from the bundles the settings plugin loads into the i18n service at `kernel:ready`, and falls back to the manifest `description` that `GET /api/settings/localization` serves. Both layers carried the developer wording, so both are rewritten and both are pinned. The four packs are hand-written: no generator feeds `service-settings/src/translations/*.ts` (no `*.generated.ts` there; `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` scan only the generated bundle sets).

## The pin

`packages/services/service-settings/src/localization-timezone-help.pin.test.ts` boots the real `SettingsServicePlugin` (its default manifests and translations) on a `LiteKernel` beside a stub `i18n` service that records every `loadTranslations(locale, data)` call. It then reads:

1. the help in every bundle the plugin loaded (the locale set is whatever the plugin loads, with a floor of en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES so the loop cannot pass over nothing); the help must be present in each locale;
2. the timezone specifier's `description` from `GET /api/settings/localization`, mounted on the service that boot registered.

It asserts each names no function identifier: no name directly followed by an opening parenthesis, and no lowerCamelCase name. A detector control asserts the old wording is flagged (`today(` and `daysFromNow`), so the detector cannot pass vacuously. The new wording itself is not pinned.

Reverse verification, at commit `40fd214174`, both legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

- ja-JP help put back to the old string: `× the translated help, in every locale the plugin loads` with `ja-JP: today()/daysFromNow の解決… expected [ 'today(', 'daysFromNow' ] to deeply equal []`; `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`.
- manifest description put back: `× the manifest description served by GET /api/settings/localization` with `expected [ 'today(', 'daysFromNow' ] to deeply equal []`; `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`.

Both went red in the expected direction. The tests import the subject by relative `src/` paths, so no `dist/` rebuild was involved.

## Verification (head `40fd214174`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 37 passed (37)`, `Tests 632 passed (632)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck`: exit 0; `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` includes the new pin and all five edited files (37 test files in the program).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings build`: `check-dts-emitted: @objectstack/service-settings - 2/2 declared declaration file(s) present.`
- Dependency closure built first: `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/service-settings^...'`, 15/15 tasks.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 63 families; all 63 run. 62 exit 0. One is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it reads every package's `dist/`, and only the closure was built here). `--ran` reconciliation: `63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. Also run, all exit 0: `check:i18n` (`OK (9 package(s) — all bundles in sync…)`), `check:i18n-stale-fill` (`OK (10 bundle set(s) — no new stale fills, 0 baselined)`), `check:i18n-coverage` (`OK (13 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`), `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:settings-bind-window`, `check:nul-bytes`.
- Lint, narrowed and proven: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the six touched `.ts` files gives 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings (no "file ignored" warning, so all six are in the linted set). This repo's `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Other Localization keys still use standard names and implementation terms in their help: `locale` ("BCP-47 locale for message catalogs and number/date formatting"), `currency` ("…render code-less amounts as plain numbers"), `default_country` ("ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code"). They are not changed here. The bounded in-place rule needs all four conditions, and its second one (a mechanical fix whose shape a ruling already fixed) does not hold: each needs new wording in four locales, and for `locale` the new wording would first need its "message catalogs" claim checked. The new pin covers only the timezone key. Rewording the others is a ruling for the seat.
- The packs disagree with each other on two keys this PR leaves alone. `currency` has no `en` help (`en` shows the two-sentence manifest literal), and zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES carry only its first sentence. `default_country` carries "Used for address and phone defaults." in es-ES and ja-JP, but not in en or zh-CN.
- The console's missing-translation warnings for these keys are tracked in objectstack-ai/objectui#11801.
